title: Backstop Issue Schema v1
description: Schema for issues — lightweight sister artifact to specs with full traceability parity. Supports bug fixes, enhancements, and technical debt tracking. Requirements and claims validated on close. Extends backstop-artifact-base-v1.

delivered_by.description: When an issue reaches `closed`, an optional pointer to the PLAN-ISSUE-NNN that delivered it. A valid delivered_by lets the close satisfy traceability by tracing to the completed backing plan instead of re-authoring requirements/claims onto the issue. The close still requires a Resolution section. Documentary only; enforced in pkg/validate/delivered_by.go.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Live: open, ready, in-progress, blocked. Success terminal: closed. Retirement terminal: replaced (superseded by a named successor — requires replaced-by), canceled (work abandoned). No deprecated state for issues.

verification.description: Test verification strategy — required from 'ready' onward. Same rules as spec: unit/security threshold 90, integration/performance threshold 80, static/build no threshold.

coverage_threshold.description: Required for unit/security (90) and integration/performance (80). Must not be set for static/build.

test_command.description: Command to run tests (e.g., 'go test ./...', 'npx vitest run')

implementation.description: Implementation scope — required from 'ready' onward. Identifies what packages are touched and summarizes the change.

requirements.description: REQ-NNN requirements — full parity with specs. Optional 'supports' traces back to bundle requirement (format: bundle-name:REQ-NNN). Required when status is 'closed'.

claims.description: CLM-NNN claims — full parity with specs. Each claim traces to a REQ-NNN and mandates test names. Required when status is 'closed'.

contracts.description: API surface contracts — provides/consumes declarations. Required from 'ready' onward.

capabilities.description: Optional UC-NNN references linking this issue to user capabilities. If present, must be non-empty with valid unique IDs.

enforcement.blocked-requires-blocked-by: Issues with status 'blocked' must have non-empty context.blocked_by array
enforcement.closed-requires-date: Issues with status 'closed' must have issue.closed date
enforcement.closed-requires-traceability: Requirements and claims arrays required and fully validated from 'ready' onward — every REQ must have ≥1 CLM, every CLM must reference a valid REQ. CONDITIONAL RELAXATION: when status is 'closed' and a valid `delivered_by` traces to a completed backing plan (PLAN-ISSUE-NNN whose spec_id matches this issue), the issue's own requirements/claims/verification/implementation/contracts are NOT required — a Resolution section plus the delivered_by pointer suffice.
enforcement.id-filename-consistency: issue.id must match the ISSUE-NNN prefix in the filename
enforcement.supports-traceability: Optional 'supports' field on requirements traces back to bundle-name:REQ-NNN
